description:
**Greetings from TCS Human Resources Team!!** 




 TCS is hiring for SAP CPI Consultant
 



  





**Role:** 
 SAP CPI Consultant
 



**Education:** 
 Minimum 15 years of full\-time education (10th, 12th and Graduation)
 



**Location:** 
 Pan India
 



  





**Skills:** 



* Hands on experience in design, development and implementation of integration flows (I\-Flow), ICOs between SAP On\-Premise (e.g. ECC, APO, PLM, etc.) with B2B systems, SAAS Cloud Applications( SAP Concur, SuccessFactors, SalesForce.com, Ariba, Hybris, etc.) using SAP Cloud Platform integration(also known as CPI/HCI/SCPi), including the use of SAP API hub, SAP Open Connectors and Integration Advisor.
* Knowledge of transport management and alert configuration in SAP Cloud Platform Integration.
* Working understanding of security standards including SAML, WSTrust, OAUTH, OpenID Connect
* Hands on experience writing Groovy Scripts or Java Scripts.
* Hans on experience in SAP PI/PO
* Knowledge of Github, CI/CD for development of applications in SAP Cloud Platform
* knowledge of SAP Cloud Connector, Identity providers, SAML, JW Tokens, SAP XSUAA, Digital certificates \& Keys
* Experience in the configuration of B2B integration protocols such as AS2, EDI (EDIFACT \& ANSI) etc.
* Experience in the configuration of adapters such as JMS, JBDC, SFTP, SOAP, IDOC, Proxy, FTPS, REST, o\-data services and web services.
* Experience with designing and implementing SAP PI/PO interfaces, Java mapping, xslt and graphical mapping
* Experience in integration with SAP modules such as: FI, SD, MM, QM, PM, etc.
* Able to work in a fast\-paced Agile development environment and in industry regulated systems. This includes producing documentation as required by the regulator.
* Excellent software development skills in Java, good understanding of JAVA J2EE, REST and SOAP based web services.
* Ability to read / develop ABAP coding is desirable, but not essential.
* Excellent communication skills (Written and Oral) , The individual must have strong interpersonal skills capable at building relationships across different functional and technical groups in the organization, capturing and aligning inputs from these groups then driving them to an agreed direction
* Experience working with remote teams (e.g. based in Poland, USA and/or India) and other 3rd party support teams (SI, vendors etc.)



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Responsible for developing inbound and outbound interfaces to/from the cloud to On Premise and Cloud to Cloud (like, Cloud instances of SAP Products)
* Analyzes, designs, develops and tests process flows in support of multiple business projects using integration technologies.
* Understands, refines and complies with integration patterns, standards, guidelines, and best practices
* Provide support for technical requirements gathering, analysis of system landscapes, technical design, and development of interfaces.
* Proactively troubleshoot and resolve system\-related issues that could impact end\-user experience, data integrity, or overall end\-to\-end system functionality.
* Provides directional oversight and mentors team members on integration development tasks.
* Actively participate in end to end project activities to ensure the team delivers effective business systems solutions.
* Analyze business processes and prepare detailed design specifications for required integration development activities
* Coordinate extensively with business users, functional and cross\-functional team members, developers, integration resources
* Works with Solution Architects to ensure that application designs utilise the appropriate integration patterns and standards
